{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, handling currency formatting
# Remove '$' and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
# Assuming 'internal test' orders are identified by a specific channel or status
# Since 'channel' has 'email' and 'paid_search', and 'status' has 'completed' and 'refunded',
# we will assume 'internal test' orders are not in the data or are filtered by status
# So we filter only 'completed' status
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
